title: Specs Composition Concern Document Schema
description: One concern of a composition, as written by a run with splitConcerns. Each concern has its own shape, requiring what it carries and permitting nothing else. Component-level definitions are referenced from component.schema.json rather than restated. (ADR-109)

CompositionApiDocument.description: The api concern of a composition: its identity and structure. Written as api.yaml by a run with splitConcerns. (ADR-109)

metadata.description: Must state `concern: api`. This is what identifies the document, and what separates it from the other concerns in root.schema.json.

description.description: Purpose and usage notes for documentation tooling.

anatomy.description: The elements that comprise the composition, corresponding largely to Figma layers

CompositionVariantsDocument.description: The variants concern of a composition: how it looks. A composition has no default/variants layering — elements and layout are the whole of its one, unvarying appearance. Written as variants.yaml by a run with splitConcerns. (ADR-109)

metadata.description: Must state `concern: variants`. This is what identifies the document, and what separates it from the other concerns in root.schema.json.

elements.description: Per-element styles, content, and children for the composition

CompositionExamplesDocument.description: The examples concern of a composition: the content it composes. Written as examples.yaml when a composition has any named slot fills bundled alongside its primary content. (ADR-109)

metadata.description: Must state `concern: examples`. This is what identifies the document, and what separates it from the other concerns in root.schema.json.

slotContent.description: Named slot fills bundled alongside this composition's primary content (ADR-042, ADR-046).
